title: Optimizing Drilling Trajectories in Multi-Material Structures Using Quantum Annealers
abstract: arXiv:2611.18121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work we present a quantum-hybrid optimization approach for planning drilling trajectories on multi-material structures, with the objective of minimizing total energy consumption. The proposed formulation models the drilling process as a constrained routing problem in which each hole must be visited while accounting for heterogeneous material properties, material-dependent drilling costs and displacement energy, as well as tool-wear penalties. Our method incorporates realistic industrial constraints, including open-path routing and mandatory grouping of holes belonging to the same material to avoid frequent tool-bit changes. The modeled problem is solved using D-Wave's Leap Constrained Quadratic Model Hybrid Solver. To evaluate performance, we benchmark instances ranging from 10 to 55 holes with varying material distributions and cost matrices. translated_title: 使用量子退火机优化多材料结构中的钻孔轨迹
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种量子-混合优化方法，用于规划多材料结构上的钻孔轨迹，目标是最小化总能耗。所提出的建模方式将钻孔过程描述为一个约束路径规划问题，其中每个孔都必须被访问，同时考虑异质材料特性、依赖于材料的钻孔成本、位移能量以及刀具磨损惩罚。该方法纳入了现实的工业约束，包括开放路径规划以及将属于同一材料的孔进行强制分组，以避免频繁更换钻头。该问题使用D-Wave的Leap约束二次模型混合求解器进行求解。为了评估性能，作者对10到55个孔、具有不同材料分布和成本矩阵的实例进行了基准测试。结果凸显了量子-混合优化在处理复杂多材料钻孔场景方面的能力。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于D-Wave Leap混合求解器的量子-混合优化方法，将多材料结构的钻孔轨迹规划建模为包含材料分组、刀具磨损等工业约束的路径优化问题，以最小化总能耗，并在10至55孔的实例上验证了该方法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a quantum-hybrid optimization approach using D-Wave's Leap hybrid solver to formulate multi-material drilling trajectory planning as a constrained routing problem with industrial constraints such as material grouping and tool-wear penalties, minimizing total energy consumption and demonstrating effectiveness on instances of 10 to 55 holes.
